study type: Secondary analysis of Demographic and Health Surveys
finding: The stillbirth rate in Ethiopia declined from 13.3 per 1000 births in 2005 to 9.2 per 1000 births in 2016, with an annual rate of reduction of 3.1%, and this decline is largely attributed to changes in women's characteristics over time.
mod_finding: An increase in cesarean delivery and health facility delivery significantly contributed to the decrease in stillbirth rate over time.
